summary: One defect: sync-collection deleted-resource response uses 207 Multi-Status instead of the RFC 6578-required 404 Not Found, which Apple clients will misinterpret.
defects: backend/src/caldav/http.rs:1417 — sync_deleted_response_xml emits <D:status>HTTP/1.1 207 Multi-Status</D:status> for deleted resources; RFC 6578 requires 404 Not Found for deleted resources in sync-collection responses. 207 is the multistatus envelope status, not a per-resource status. Inconsistent with the codebase's own multiget 404 handling (http.rs:1462). Apple CalDAV clients expect 404 to recognize deletions. Test at backend/tests/caldav_event_resource.rs:2935 asserts the wrong status, masking the defect.
follow_up: Fix sync_deleted_response_xml to use HTTP/1.1 404 Not Found and update the test assertion at caldav_event_resource.rs:2935 to match.
important_context: The sync-collection implementation is otherwise correct: HMAC-verified opaque tokens, ordered change-log pagination with no-skip guarantee, safe 400 on invalid tokens, transactional change recording with tombstones.
